errors.evidence: The machine description reverses the color mapping. Blue bars represent the statutory minimum wage and purple bars represent 60% of the median wage.
The values for the statutory minimum wage are incorrect compared to those shown in the figure: they should be 8.50, 8.50, 8.84, 8.85, 9.19, 9.35, 9.55, 10.52, 12.00, 12.41 and 12.82.
